table.name: Gear ratios (1st-5th)
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 02 §1] Matches the logged turbine/output ratio. FX Sport RATIOS must use these.

table.name: Cold-ATF 5th-gear inhibit threshold
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 02 §5] No 4→5 upshift while ATF temp 3FB794 < this (unless cal 0x6055E bit 5).

table.name: Shift-schedule pedal source flags
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 02 §2] Bit 1 = 0 (stock): shift lines read throttle_b 3FB766 (from ECM CAN 0x23E b6); 1: read the accel pedal 3FB992 (0x23D b2). The factory shift speeds (FSM AT-62) match the lines at y = 128 (half) and 255 (full), so y is a 0-255 full-travel scale. Rescales every line if flipped.

table.name: Pattern-selection feature flags
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 02 §3] b0 mode switch → pattern 1, b2/b4 manual inputs → patterns 2/6, b5 analog-input path.

table.name: Sporty pattern: throttle-rate trigger
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 02 §3] Pattern 5 ("sporty") latches when the throttle rise over 3 ticks exceeds this. Lower = triggers more easily.

table.name: Line pressure: minimum clamp
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 03 §3] Base line pressure is clamped to [min, max]. Unit 0.1 kPa STRONG: the max clamp 1372 kPa matches the FSM D-range stall line pressure 1310-1500 kPa (AT-53, TCM 07 §1); the 490 kPa minimum sits ~100 kPa above the FSM idle spec (absolute vs gauge, open).

table.name: Line pressure: maximum clamp
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 03 §3] Unit 0.1 kPa STRONG: the max clamp 1372 kPa matches the FSM D-range stall line pressure 1310-1500 kPa (AT-53, TCM 07 §1); the 490 kPa minimum sits ~100 kPa above the FSM idle spec (absolute vs gauge, open).

table.name: Line pressure: fixed minimum mode
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 03 §3] Used when 3FB1E4 bit 7. Unit 0.1 kPa STRONG: the max clamp 1372 kPa matches the FSM D-range stall line pressure 1310-1500 kPa (AT-53, TCM 07 §1); the 490 kPa minimum sits ~100 kPa above the FSM idle spec (absolute vs gauge, open).

table.name: ATF temperature sensor 1 curve
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 08 §5] Converts the filtered inverted sensor voltage (3FB792/793 = 255 − 3FB77B/77C) into the ATF temperature 3FB794 (id 110B) that every ATF-temp threshold in this calibration uses (cold 4→5 inhibit 0x606D6, P17xx debounce 0x4B0AD, lift-foot minimum 0x606E9, line-pressure ATF factor 0x60534). CONFIRMED live: 3FB77B 47 → 3FB792 207 → 3FB794 132 = this curve. FSM reference ATF TEMP SE 1: 2.2 V at 0 °C, 1.8 V at 20 °C, 0.6 V at 80 °C → curve ≈ 88 / 100 / 151. So the "cold" thresholds near 45-55 raw are well below 0 °C. Note: the K-line id reads about 18 lower than 3FB794 at the same voltage (conversion not found); use the RAM value with this curve.

table.name: ATF temperature sensor 2 curve
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 08 §5] Converts the filtered inverted sensor voltage (3FB792/793 = 255 − 3FB77B/77C) into the ATF temperature 3FB7A5 (id 110C) that every ATF-temp threshold in this calibration uses (cold 4→5 inhibit 0x606D6, P17xx debounce 0x4B0AD, lift-foot minimum 0x606E9, line-pressure ATF factor 0x60534). CONFIRMED live: 3FB77B 47 → 3FB792 207 → 3FB794 132 = this curve. FSM ATF TEMP SE 2: 2.2 V at 0 °C, 1.7 V at 20 °C, 0.45 V at 80 °C → curve ≈ 83 / 95 / 153. So the "cold" thresholds near 45-55 raw are well below 0 °C. Note: the K-line id reads about 18 lower than 3FB794 at the same voltage (conversion not found); use the RAM value with this curve.

table.name: Shift-phase torque-band edges
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 04 §2] Column selector for the phase-timer banks: first edge ≥ turbine torque (engine torque × converter ratio, 3FB4FA). 32767 = open end.

table.name: Shift phase timers A 1→2, normal
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 04 §2] Sequencer A (3FB7DA, FUN_3FCA4): each phase lasts the tick count of the turbine-torque column, or ends early once shift progress 3FB2FC passes column 0 (upshift: progress > col 0; downshift: < col 0). Phase 1 adds the learned offset 3FB3D2; phase 2 of an upshift adds 3FB54A and is at least 0x6883E[shift]. A/B = the two element sequencers. On upshifts A (3FB502) is the engaging-element apply command: it starts at the initial-apply table and climbs by 3FB3D4 per step while B holds 10000, then jumps to 10000 when the shift completes; on coast downshifts B ramps while A holds (CONFIRMED live 2026-11-19, TCM 06). 1 tick = 20 ms: the sequencers run in the 20 ms task T44 (schedule table 0x10C00, CONFIRMED; live ramp steps every ~20-25 ms, TCM 06 §1).

On upshifts A (3FB502) is the engaging-element apply command: it starts at the initial-apply table and climbs by 3FB3D4 per step while B holds 10000, then jumps to 10000 when the shift completes; on coast downshifts B ramps while A holds (CONFIRMED live 2026-11-19, TCM 06). 1 tick = 20 ms: the sequencers run in the 20 ms task T44 (schedule table 0x10C00, CONFIRMED; live ramp steps every ~20-25 ms, TCM 06 §1).

table.name: Initial engaging-element pressure
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 04 §3, TCM 05 §1] 3FB502 start value = table[shift*4 + 3FB7F8] (FUN_41B50), skipped when 3FB7F8 = 0xFF. Columns = engaging element (CONFIRMED, TCM 05 §1: element tables 0x4B2E8/0x4B406/0x4B414 match the FSM clutch chart, and every nonzero stock cell sits in its shift's engaging-element column). Unit 0.1 kPa CANDIDATE.

table.name: Torque-cut extra apply ramp
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 06 §2] Extra apply-ramp step 3FB3DE added to 3FB502 every 20 ms with 3FB3D4 (FUN_25E9C/25E44): 3DE = min(K × 3FB510 / 1024, max step), 3FB510 = (engine torque 3FB310 − 3FB30E) × converter ratio 3FB312 / 1024. Gated by the torque-reduction request 3FB872 (CAN 0x253 b3): active once the cut has lasted more than col 0 ticks (3FB46A) and until col 1 ticks after it ends (3FB46C). Stock K = 0 for all four upshifts, so 3DE = 0 (CONFIRMED live). A higher K firms up the apply while the engine torque is being cut.

table.name: Upshift apply-pressure end target coefficients
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §2] Engaging-element pressure end target 3FB504 = max(a·|T_turbine|/1024 · gain/1024 + b·hold/1024 + offset, floor) (FUN_261A8); offset = captured pressure − (c·|T| + d·hold)/1024 so the target starts at the current pressure. a = the main firmness-vs-torque knob. Pedal released → floor only. Stock b = d = 0. Same pressure unit as the apply ramp (10000 = full).

table.name: Downshift apply-pressure end target coefficients
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §2] 3FB508 = max(a·|T_turbine|/1024 + b·3FB430/1024, floor) (FUN_2624C); 3FB430 = 0x64E40 or the released element's initial-apply cell. Stock b = 0.

table.name: Downshift start detection A (3FB17F b6)
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §4] Flag sets when the measured ratio 3FB2FC (turbine/output x1024) passes the threshold or the shift timer 3FB4A0 reaches the tick limit (20 ms ticks). Stock thresholds = from-gear ratio x1024 + 1-2 % (2339/1528/1044/874), i.e. "the ratio has left the old gear".

table.name: Downshift start detection B (3FB187 b5)
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §4] Flag sets when the measured ratio 3FB2FC (turbine/output x1024) passes the threshold or the shift timer 3FB4A0 reaches the tick limit (20 ms ticks). Stock thresholds = from-gear ratio x1024 + 1-2 % (2339/1528/1044/874), i.e. "the ratio has left the old gear".

table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §3] b0 = 1 (stock): a same-direction request during a shift sets 3FB187 b2 and switches to the continuous-shift phase-timer/ramp banks. b1: only in patterns 4/7.

table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §3] Cycles after arming in which a lift-off counts. Stock 0.

table.name: Fallback phase-timer set speed limit
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 05 §3] km/h (stock 5).

table.name: Apply ramp steps 1→2, T ≤ 0, speed ≤ 25
table.description: [STRONG, TCM 04 §3] Number of ticks the engaging-element pressure takes to ramp from its start to the target (3FB3E0 = (target − start) / steps, FUN_41B88/41C28). Fewer steps = steeper ramp = firmer, shorter shift. One step per 20 ms (task T44). The adaptive cell would scale the ramp, but the stock clamp holds it at 256 (TCM 06 §3). In stock the learned cell is clamped to exactly 256 before use (see "Adaptive cell clamp"), so the learning has no effect on shifts.

table.name: Adaptive cell clamp 1→2
table.description: [CONFIRMED, TCM 06 §3] Apply ramp used = base ramp 3FB3E0 × clamp(learned cell, min, max) / 256 (FUN_41CCC). Stock min = max = 256 for every shift and torque band, so the learned cells are ignored (CONFIRMED live: 3FB3D4 = 3FB3E0 in every logged upshift). Widening the range turns shift-time adaptation on.
